_comment: Template for the Teams cards created by 911 Setup's 'Generate Teams Cards' stage. Cards are driven by the EB 922 Schedule's CURRENT PIPELINE sheet: every row whose DEPT. is '911' AND whose STATUS is 'NEED TEAMS/SETUP' becomes one card in the MODELING bucket of the SOPO D911 PIPELINE plan. Edit this file to change the cards - no flow change is needed unless the payload SHAPE changes. 'label_map' mirrors the plan's label slots top-to-bottom (category1 = top of the label list); if a label is renamed or reordered IN TEAMS, update it here too.
_comment_tube_only: Checklist items dropped when the source material is not a tube (a tube-laser program is meaningless on saw stock).
_comment_schedule: Which CURRENT PIPELINE rows become cards. Matched case-insensitively on the stripped cell value.
_comment_machine: SAW CUT vs TUBE LASER, read off the schedule's NOTES text (column D; falls back to the BATCH LIST 'Description' when NOTES is blank). An explicit '(TL)' / '(SAW)' marker in the note always wins. Otherwise the FIRST 'shape' keyword found - in the order listed here - decides. A material that matches nothing gets no machine label and is reported at the end of the run, rather than guessing.
_comment_labels: Slot keys, not names - the flow stays dumb and only sees categoryN. Order here mirrors the plan's label list: 1 DIFFICULT, 2 MEDIUM, 3 SIMPLE, 4 SAW CUT, 5 TUBE LASER.
